procedure.method: Fresh independent review in this session; no spawn, fork, resume or peer review inspection. Read the pinned packet, literal case, rubric, rules, compact addendum, method and adapter. Packet source_assets and protected_layouts are both empty, so there were no source-asset opens or protected-layout reads. Read the five pinned native-evidence manifests and verified all fifteen pinned PNG hashes, byte counts and dimensions without following any embedded unlisted path. Actually displayed every exact PNG with tools.view_image(detail=original), forwarding each returned image for visual inspection. The completed poster-opening sequence was M1 native, usage720, thumbnail320; M2 native, usage720, thumbnail320; M3 native, usage720, thumbnail320; M4 native, usage720, thumbnail320; M5 native, usage720, thumbnail320. All fifteen displays preceded the first deliberate copy-reading/transcription stage and every judgment or score. First readings below are from those displayed pixels, preserving their observed soft wraps; no ambiguity-triggered revisit was necessary. PNG metadata subsequently confirmed RGB opaque native files and the ratio calculations. No tool event or runtime session identity is invented.

evidence.location: foreground pavement and right glass facade
evidence.observation: Large receding stone paving, long cast shadows and the reflective facade occupy most of the image. They express the changing light and human traces of an ordinary walk; the visual is substantive rather than a small pasted image or a texture behind lettering.

evidence.location: diagonal stone ledge, pavement shadows and reflected street at right
evidence.observation: The threshold directs attention to a reflected pedestrian and street, while elongated shadows mark passing people and sunlight. These recognizable nonglyph relationships supply the requested urban observation.

content_form.observation: The low viewpoint makes ordinary paving and reflected passersby the subject. Light and traces are materially present in the composition, giving the walking invitation a specific visual counterpart.

hierarchy.observation: A large two-line title establishes the first read, the body follows directly below, and the stone edge carries the eye into the glass reflection. The sequence is clear even though body reading comfort falls short.

hierarchy.location: upper-left title versus full-width street scene
hierarchy.observation: The title remains the recognizable typographic anchor and the reflected scene remains distinct; no competing copy role interrupts the sequence.

typography.location: title and four-line body at upper left
typography.observation: The Korean title has clean serif forms and readable word spacing; the body reads exactly, with consistent punctuation and no visible malformed glyph.

The thin body is small relative to the 720-wide field and the large title. It remains decipherable but requires close attention, particularly through the comma-bearing second line and final line; comfortable paragraph reading is unresolved.

space.location: left text area, central pavement and right facade
space.observation: The text is inset from the top and left rather than touching the frame. The broad foreground is active through shadow and stone joints, while the receding ledge balances the upper-left copy with the right reflection.

image_material.location: stone ledge, glass frames and ground
image_material.observation: Stone texture, sharp foreground joints, reflective glass and softer distant figures have a coherent photographic treatment. The angled ground and ledge form readable depth rather than disconnected decorative surfaces.

emotion_control.location: warm light across the paving and quiet reflected pedestrians
emotion_control.observation: The sustained golden light and unhurried low viewpoint create a welcoming, observant mood. Human presence is small enough to leave attention on familiar surfaces becoming newly visible.

ai_slop.location: foreground joints, facade and reflected street
ai_slop.observation: The visible forms maintain a coherent street/threshold/reflection relationship, without arbitrary badges, decorative symbols or pseudo-copy. Distant detail is soft, but no definite contradictory construction dominates the message.

residuals: The small, thin usage720 body is readable but insufficiently comfortable; typography remains 3 and the literal style/readability condition is FAIL.

Its warm photographic street observation is the closest overall relation to M3 in the set; strong distinctness relies on the differences in image expression, tonal handling and body typography rather than a unique layout.

evidence.observation: A large red shoe-sole print, a second cropped print, diagonal stone joints and long crossbar shadows form substantive walking imagery across most of the field, beyond the headline and background grain.

evidence.location: red prints on blue paving and angular shadows on yellow paving
evidence.observation: The prints communicate steps and human traces; shadows transform everyday paving into something noticed during a walk. These content-grounded forms remain recognizable at use scale.

content_form.location: red sole prints and the diagonal lit paving
content_form.observation: A sequence of visible sole impressions gives walking a concrete action/traces motif, while crossbar shadows supply the newly noticed light. The imagery and headline address the same content.

hierarchy.observation: The single-line heavy title reads first, the two sentence-lines directly below read second, and the large red print provides a strong secondary visual focal point without replacing the copy.
The title survives at thumbnail scale and is separated clearly from the small supporting body.

typography.observation: The stout Korean sans forms are coherent rather than malformed; word boundaries and comma/period marks remain clear.
The body has sufficient stroke weight and a clean two-sentence progression over the pale ground. Reading it is comfortable without needing to recover missing characters.

space.location: diagonal light/dark boundary and bottom-cropped print
space.observation: The upper-left text occupies the lit region while red prints inhabit the opposing blue ground. Cropping the lower print implies the continuation of a path, and pavement diagonals activate the otherwise open lower area.

image_material.observation: Distressed red print edges, blue ground grain, yellow light and thin slab joints form one controlled graphic surface. The footprint remains an identifiable sole pattern through the distress.

emotion_control.observation: The forceful color contrast and bright red walking traces create an alert, lively invitation. The effect is intentional and more energetic than the contemplative architectural posters.

ai_slop.observation: The repeated motif is a meaningful walking trace, and the ground joints explain the angled field. No arbitrary icons or invented informational elements are visible; cropping and grain support the composition rather than concealing a broken focal object.

residuals: The footprint is a direct, familiar walking symbol rather than an exceptionally surprising concept.
The grain and distress carry the print-like identity, while the slab/shadow/footprint relationships provide the necessary substance; material texture alone would not establish its distinctness.

evidence.observation: The handle shows a place repeatedly touched, and the worn threshold shows accumulated use. Their highlights, chips and pavement joints turn familiar urban details into the subject of attention.

content_form.observation: The poster finds the project content in touch-worn hardware and repeatedly walked stone. This is specific everyday evidence of human traces, with bright handle highlights supplying a local light event.

hierarchy.location: title/body on left wall, handle at upper right and curb below

The two-line title remains recognizable without competing decorative copy.

typography.observation: The Korean serif forms and open word spaces are harmonious with the fine-edged scene. Commas and periods are distinct, and no damaged or invented glyph is visible.

typography.location: four-line body on the pale wall
typography.observation: Body size, clear line spacing and dark-on-pale contrast allow the sentences to be followed comfortably; soft wraps do not interrupt word boundaries.

space.location: left wall, right door strip and diagonal step
space.observation: The right-hand vertical door supplies weight against the upper-left text, while the step opens a substantial downward diagonal. The lower space is occupied by relevant worn ground rather than left empty after copy placement.

image_material.location: handle, chipped paint and stone surfaces
image_material.observation: Fine dark edges, stippled wear and pale tonal areas produce a consistent detailed drawn appearance across metal, plaster and stone. The hardware and paving remain identifiable despite the dense surface detail.

emotion_control.location: pale wall and quietly worn threshold
emotion_control.observation: The restrained light and close attention to abrasion communicate quiet, patient observation of a familiar place. It has an archival stillness rather than the energy of M2 or luminous intimacy of M4.

ai_slop.location: door boundary, curb joints and small plant growth
ai_slop.observation: The weathering occurs on readable architectural surfaces and the small growth sits in ground joints. There is no visible arbitrary symbolic decoration, pseudo-copy or dominant disconnected object. The dense fine marks are a finish choice that remains locally coherent.

residuals: The very dense wear and fine edges make local material treatment more conspicuous than a loose spontaneous drawing would be; the scene remains coherent and readable.

M1 is its closest overall stylistic relation. Its line/stipple treatment, pale compact architectural crop and serif body establish a different identity, but the pair is less far apart than either is from M2.

evidence.location: window and lower street reflection
evidence.observation: The large window, corner, curb and wet paving form a complete nonglyph scene. The warm reflected stripe continues through much of the lower half, contributing far more than a small ornament or generic background texture.

evidence.location: orange window light and reflection among dark paving slabs
evidence.observation: A household plant behind the window suggests everyday human occupancy, and reflected light changes the appearance of the street outside. Both relationships support the invitation to notice light and traces while walking.

content_form.location: lit window, plant and wet ground
content_form.observation: The painted scene links a small sign of indoor life with a large outdoor light reflection. It gives the project a specific urban discovery rather than merely supplying a decorative warm background.

hierarchy.location: cream title/body at upper left versus orange window
hierarchy.observation: The title anchors the text sequence and the full paragraph sits clearly beneath it. The window provides the visual counterweight and the reflection extends the reading through the scene without introducing additional copy.
Both the title anchor and the principal nonglyph light relationship survive the small view.

typography.location: cream Korean title and supporting sans body
typography.observation: Title and body have deliberate weight contrast, intact glyph forms and readable punctuation. The serif headline remains optically calm against the expressive brushwork.
The body is comfortably sized and well separated line by line; light letters stay legible against the darker area without breaking the two sentences into unrelated fragments.

space.location: corner vertical, left text block and diagonal reflected light below
space.observation: The corner separates the text-bearing wall from the bright window, and the foreground reflection supplies an asymmetric continuation beneath them. Margins and occupied lower space are intentional rather than leftover blank area.

image_material.location: window frame, brush-painted walls and wet paving
image_material.observation: Broad and smaller brush marks describe distinct surfaces while maintaining the orange/dark-violet light relationship. Frame, plant, curb and reflected paving remain recognizable through the painted abstraction.

emotion_control.location: orange interior light against the dark street
emotion_control.observation: The controlled warm/cool contrast conveys intimate urban evening life and the pleasure of slowing down outside an ordinary window. The effect is expressive yet organized, with no need to flatten the painted genre.

ai_slop.observation: The plant silhouette belongs to the window interior and the reflection belongs to the paving outside. Brush marks vary with the larger forms; no arbitrary decorative badges, gibberish text or dominant contradictory scene element is visible.

residuals: Its strongest content relationship is light and inhabited-window traces; walking itself is implied by the curb and street viewpoint.
The thick brush finish is conspicuous, but the window/reflection relationship remains the substantive concept rather than texture alone.

evidence.location: grate at right and cracked paving through the lower field
evidence.observation: Large repeated grate openings and slab forms occupy most of the image and establish a recognizable ordinary urban ground surface. They remain substantive without the type and are not merely granular texture.

evidence.location: light wedge, worn slabs and diagonal grate
evidence.observation: The light strip reveals scuffed street surfaces and the rhythmic drain openings invite close attention to a normally overlooked object. This directly supports the project theme of seeing familiar routes afresh.

content_form.location: diagonal drain and abrasion in the paving
content_form.observation: A normally overlooked street object is enlarged into the composition, and the light cut reveals wear around it. The urban-walk subject is grounded in this close observation rather than an unrelated motif.

hierarchy.location: single-line headline, four-line body and grate slots
hierarchy.observation: The black title reads first on the light wedge, the complete paragraph follows directly, and the strong grate rhythm pulls the eye down and right into the street detail.
The title stays recognizable and the drain remains the main nonglyph form at thumbnail scale.

typography.location: serif headline and sans body on pale paving
typography.observation: The Korean forms are coherent, word spacing is visible and the body punctuation is intact. A compact single-line title changes the density of the anchor while maintaining the same supplied copy.
The body has clear stroke weight, sufficient line separation and a largely pale reading area; its sentences can be followed comfortably despite the coarser image texture around the edges.

space.location: upper-left light wedge and off-axis foreground
space.observation: The wedge offers a controlled copy area while large diagonal slabs and the right-hand drain occupy the rest of the frame. The right-edge crop and converging joints make the close view intentional rather than a pasted object beside text.

image_material.location: coarse paving grain and solid grate openings
image_material.observation: A restricted cream/teal/black tonal construction and coarse surface marks create a consistent ink-like graphic finish. The solid openings remain clean enough to contrast with the distressed paving and preserve object legibility.

emotion_control.location: stark dark slots and diagonal pale light
emotion_control.observation: The hard contrast and close crop create alert, tactile curiosity about an ordinary street surface. This is more investigative and rough-edged than the warm reflection of M1 or intimate glow of M4.

ai_slop.location: grate frame, slots and slab joints
ai_slop.observation: The dark repeated shapes are meaningful drain openings within a readable frame; joints and wear belong to the ground plane. Texture is dense but coherent with the graphic finish, and no arbitrary symbol, pseudo-copy or dominant contradictory object is visible.

residuals: Dense coarse grain makes the lower paving visually busy; the clear grate openings and pale copy wedge keep the scene and paragraph legible.
The restricted ink-like finish is a large part of the identity, but its oblique drain rhythm and hard tonal organization supply formal distinctions beyond a palette change.

recording_adapter.limit: Metadata bindings and attestations do not prove semantic viewing or source fidelity

evidence.location: golden pavement depth and glass reflection
evidence.observation: Continuous photographic tone, softer distant street detail, warm directional sunlight and a medium dark serif anchor create a contemplative documentary identity. Relative to M3, it opens out to a deep street/reflection and uses a sans body rather than a pale, finely edged architectural close study; this is the nearest stylistic pair.

evidence.location: heavy blue headline, yellow shadows and large red prints
evidence.observation: Hard three-color contrast, a heavy single-line gothic headline and large distressed sole impressions make an assertive graphic walking poster. The emblematic action, planar shadow geometry and forceful type distinguish it from the four quieter architectural-detail treatments, rather than color alone.

evidence.location: pale wall, serif body, fine-edged handle/stone detail
evidence.observation: Fine contour/stipple definition, restrained pale neutrals, serif body and compact touch-worn hardware study establish archival stillness. It shares architectural attention with M1 but differs in image expression, tonal depth and typographic voice; it also contrasts with M5 coarse ink masses and M4 broad luminous brushwork.

evidence.location: thick painted wall, orange window and wet reflection
evidence.observation: Broad expressive brush marks, dark violet/orange lighting, cream serif anchor and an inhabited-window/reflection relationship form an intimate painted nocturne. The interior/exterior warmth and stroke construction are visibly different from M3 fine pale definition and M5 restricted flattened ink treatment.

evidence.location: oblique drain slots and coarse teal/cream ground
evidence.observation: A steep close crop, large solid black slot rhythm, restricted flattened tone, coarse ink-like grain and a compact single-line serif anchor give the familiar ground a harder investigative expression. It is not merely M2 with a palette swap: the main visual is an abstracted everyday drain rather than bright walking emblems, and its emotion is quieter and rougher.

residuals: The five achieved identities are strongly distinct, with M1/M3 the closest relationship and therefore less separation than the other pairings. The comparison rests on visible image expression, tonal organization, type treatment and emotional effect together, not material labels or the shared upper-left reading order.

The set is not ready for an all-dimensions editorial pass: M1 typography is 3 and its mandatory style check fails the requested body-reading comfort, even though exact copy, count, ratios, substantive visuals and diversity are satisfactory.

This is one independent editorial assessment only. No peer scores or three-critic combined result were inspected or inferred. No source identity or protected-geometry conclusion is applicable because the packet supplies neither.
